"Be miserable ya motivate—jo karna hai, karo."
"Moon ko target karo; miss bhi karoge toh stars ke paas."
"Goals pe stubborn, methods pe flexible."
"Beginning change nahi, but jahan ho start karke end change."
"Moon pe target. Miss bhi karo, stars ke beech landing."
"Failure ko aage badhne ke liye use karo."
"Big socho, abhi act karo."
Jab tak kaam na ho jaye, tab tak impossible lagta hai.
Bade goals rakho, fail huye toh bhi sabse aage hoge.
Jo tum chahte ho, woh darr ke uss paar hai.
